title: Describing changes over time / Kuelezea mabadiliko katika muda
bridge: Kiingereza, kuelezea mabadiliko hutumia mistari yenye 'get', 'become' na 'turn' ambayo katika Kihispania mara nyingi hutafsiriwa kama 'kuwa', 'kufanyika' au 'kuingia'. Akiwokoa Kihispania, Kiingereza hautumii fiili 'kuwa' au 'kuwa na' na vituo vya kuelezea mabadiliko; badala yake, hutumia fiili hizi hasa. Pia, Kiingereza hutoa tofauti kati ya halali nzuri ('have changed') na zamani rahisi ('changed'), jambo ambalo halitovuti kabisa na halali nzuri na zamani isiyobainika katika Kihispania. Wanafunzi wenye kusema Kihispania wanakabiliwa kutafsiriya kina 'nina chuki zaidi' kama 'I am more tired' badala ya 'I have gotten more tired'.
rule: Kuelezea mabadiliko kiingereza: 1) Tumia 'get' + kitendo (au kilingana) kwa mabadiliko ya kasi au ya muda: 'get older', 'get better', 'get colder'. 2) Tumia 'become' + kitendo/jina kwa mabadiliko ya zaidi ya kudumu au rasmi: 'become a teacher', 'become famous'. 3) Tumia 'turn' + rangi au kitendo kwa mabadiliko ya hali inayonekana: 'turn red', 'turn pale'. 4) Kwa mabadiliko ya hali ya kimwili au ya afya, pia unaweza kutumia 'grow' (kuzidi) na 'fall' (kupotea) katika maneno ya kawaida: 'grow old', 'fall asleep'. 5) Na 'used to' hutumia kuhusu nyakati za zamani ambazo hazipo sasa: 'I used to live here'. 6) Na 'no longer' na 'still' huunganisha hali: 'I no longer smoke', 'I still work here'. 7) Halali nzuri hutumika wakati mabadiliko ni muhimu katika halali: 'The town has changed a lot'. Hutumia 'kuwa' au 'kuwa na' + kitendo kama katika Kihispania: 'estoy cansado' si 'I am tired' ikiwa unataka kusema umeongezeka utajiri, bali 'I have gotten tired'.

concept_examples.text: People are getting older.
concept_examples.translation: Watu wanakua.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ˈpiːpəl ɑːr ˈɡetɪŋ ˈoʊldər/

concept_examples.text: The city has changed a lot.
concept_examples.translation: Mji umeabadilika sana.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ðə ˈsɪti hæz tʃeɪndʒd ə lɑːt/

concept_examples.text: She became more confident after the course.
concept_examples.translation: Alikuwa na ujasiri zaidi baada ya masomo.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ʃi bɪˈkeɪm mɔːr ˈkɑːnfɪdənt ˈæftər ðə kɔːrs/

concept_examples.text: The leaves turn yellow in autumn.
concept_examples.translation: Majani huwa na rangi ya kijani katika mwanzo wa mwaka.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ðə liːvz tɜːrn ˈjɛloʊ ɪn ˈɔːtəm/

common_error.wrong: I am more tired now than before.
common_error.correct: I have gotten more tired now.
common_error.correct_alt: I have become more tired now.
common_error.explanation: Hitilafu huhudhuria kwa sababu katika Kihispania hutumia 'estoy más cansado' kuelezea mabadiliko ya hali. Lakini kiingereza, 'I am tired' huelezea hali ya sasa, si mabadiliko. Kuelezea kwamba kuna mabadiliko, unapaswa kutumia halali nzuri na 'get' au 'become' (au 'have gotten' / 'have become'). Unaweza kusema 'I am more tired' tu ikiwa unalinganisha na muda mwingine, lakini hawaelezei kwamba kuna mabadiliko. Epuka kutafsiriya kina na fikiria ikiwa unuelezea hali au mabadiliko.

examples.original: It is getting colder.
examples.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ˈɡetɪŋ ˈkoʊldər/
examples.translation: Inaongezeka baridi (inakua baridi zaidi).
examples.note: Tumia 'get' + kilingana kwa mabadiliko ya kasi. Katika Kihispania mara nyingi hutumia halali ya kuendelea 'está haciendo' lakini kiingereza pia unaweza kutumia 'is getting'.

examples.original: My English is getting better.
examples.phonetic: /maɪ ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ ɪz ˈɡetɪŋ ˈbɛtər/
examples.translation: Kiingereza changu kinaboresha (kinakua bora zaidi).
examples.note: Hapa 'get better' ina maana kama 'kufanya bora zaidi' katika Kihispania. Usijaribu na 'kuwa bora zaidi'.

examples.original: The days are getting longer.
examples.phonetic: /ðə deɪz ɑːr ˈɡetɪŋ ˈlɔːŋɡər/
examples.translation: Siku zinaongezeka urefu.
examples.note: Kumbuka kwamba 'long' ni silaba moja, lakini kilingana ni 'longer' na -er.

examples.original: He became famous after the video.
examples.phonetic: /hi bɪˈkeɪm ˈfeɪməs ˈæftər ðə ˈvɪdi.oʊ/
examples.translation: Alifanyika maarufu baada ya video.
examples.note: Kwa mabadiliko ya utaratibu (maarufu, tajiri) inapendekezwa 'become'. Katika Kihispania hutumia 'hacerse'.

examples.original: The situation became complicated.
examples.phonetic: /ðə ˌsɪtʃuˈeɪʃən bɪˈkeɪm ˈkɑːmplɪkeɪtɪd/
examples.translation: Hali ilikuwa na changamoto.
examples.note: Hapa 'become complicated' ina maana kama 'kufanyika na changamoto'.

examples.original: She became a doctor in 2010.
examples.phonetic: /ʃi bɪˈkeɪm ə ˈdɑːktər ɪn tuː ˈθaʊzənd ˈtɛn/
examples.translation: Alifanyika daktari mwaka 2010.
examples.note: Na vitendo au vituo, hutumia 'become' + jina bila kifupi.

levels.label: Expressing changes with used to and no longer
levels.translation: Kuelezea mabadiliko na used to na no longer

examples.original: I used to live in Madrid.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ juːst tʊ lɪv ɪn məˈdrɪd/
examples.translation: Nilikuwa na kuwaka katika Madrid.
examples.note: Kuelezea tabia au hali za zamani ambazo hazipo sasa, hutumia 'used to' + fiili ya msingi.

examples.original: I no longer eat meat.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ noʊ ˈlɔːŋɡər iːt miːt/
examples.translation: Sisi hatuendi tena nyama.
examples.note: Katika Kihispania hutumia 'ya no', kiingereza 'no longer' ni zaidi ya rasmi kuliko 'don't... anymore'.

examples.original: She didn't use to smoke, but now she does.
examples.phonetic: /ʃi ˈdɪdnt juːst tʊ smoʊk bʌt naʊ ʃi dʌz/
examples.translation: Hakukuwa na kufanya sigara, lakini sasa ndiyo.
examples.note: Katika salama hutumia 'didn't use to' (bila -d mwisho katika 'use'). Tajiri na usemi: /juːst/.

title: Speculating and making deductions / Kutafakari na kufanya makusanyiko
bridge: Katika Kiingereza, tunatumia 'must', 'might', 'could', 'can't' + infinitive ili kufanya makusanyiko. Jambo muhimu ni kwamba 'must' husema kuhusu makusanyiko yenye uhakika mkubwa (ya kiwango juu) na 'can't' husema kuhusu ukatili wa uhakika; 'might', 'may' na 'could' husema kuhusu uhitsuaji. Heshima: Usitumie 'must not' ili kufanya makusanyiko ya kinyume, kwa sababu katika Kiingereza 'must not' maana yake ni kuzuia.
rule: Ili kufanya makusanyiko katika hali ya sasa katika Kiingereza, tunatumia mifano ya mifumo inayofuata iliyofuatwa na sura ya msingi ya kiswahili: 'must' (makusanyiko ya uhakika kwamba jambo fulani ni kweli), 'can't' (makusanyiko ya uhakika kwamba jambo fulani si kweli), 'might', 'may', 'could' (uhitsuaji, zaidi ya uhakika). Ili kusema kuhusu wakati uliopita, tunatumia 'must have + past participle', 'can't have + past participle', 'might have + past participle', n.k. Mifumo ni: mwanzo + mfano + kiswahili cha msingi (sasa) au mfano + have + past participle (wakati uliopita). Mashwara: Katika Kihispania, 'debe de ser' na 'no puede ser' ni sawa, lakini katika Kiingereza hatusemi 'must not be' ili kufanya makusanyiko ya kinyume; tunatumia 'can't be'.

concept_examples.text: He must be tired after the long trip.
concept_examples.translation: Anawapewa kuwa amechoka baada ya safari ndefu.
concept_examples.phonetic: /hiː mʌst biː ˈtaɪərd ˈæftər ðə lɔːŋ trɪp/

concept_examples.text: She can't be serious about moving to another country.
concept_examples.translation: Hawezi kuwa anasema kweli kuhusu kuhamia nchi nyingine.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ʃiː kænt biː ˈsɪriəs əˈbaʊt ˈmuːvɪŋ tuː əˈnʌðər ˈkʌntri/

concept_examples.text: They might have forgotten the meeting.
concept_examples.translation: Wanaweza kuwa wamesahau mikusanyiko.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ðeɪ maɪt hæv fərˈɡɒtən ðə ˈmiːtɪŋ/

concept_examples.text: It could rain later, so take an umbrella.
concept_examples.translation: Inaweza kushua baadaye, kwa hiyo chukua mvua.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ɪt kʊd reɪn ˈleɪtər soʊ teɪk ən ʌmˈbrelə/

common_error.wrong: He must not be at home because the lights are off.
common_error.correct: He can't be at home because the lights are off.
common_error.correct_alt: He must be out because the lights are off.
common_error.explanation: Hitilafu hii hutokea kwa sababu katika Kihispania husema 'no debe estar' ili kuhusu makusanyiko ya kinyume, lakini katika Kiingereza, 'must not' husema kuhusu kuzuia ('no debe' = hana ruhusa). Ili kuhusu kwamba jambo fulani ni staha au si kweli, tunatumia 'can't' (au 'couldn't' kwa ufanisi zaidi). Badiliko 'must be out' ni sahihi kwa sababu maana yake ni sawa: kuhusu kwamba hatuko nyumbani.

examples.original: You're a journalist. You must meet a lot of people.
examples.phonetic: /jʊər ə ˈdʒɜːrnəlɪst. juː mʌst miːt ə lɒt əv ˈpiːpl/
examples.translation: U ni mwandishi wa habari. Unapaswa kujua watu wengi.
examples.note: Tunatumia 'must' wakati tunapo karibu na uhakika kuhusu jambo fulani kwa sababu kuna ushahidi. Katika Kihispania, 'debe de'.

examples.original: That can't be the right answer.
examples.phonetic: /ðæt kænt biː ðə raɪt ˈænsər/
examples.translation: Hiyo hawezi kuwa jibu sahihi.
examples.note: Tunatumia 'can't' ili kusema kwamba jambo fulani ni staha. Katika Kihispania, 'no puede ser'.

examples.original: He must have a lot of money because he drives a Ferrari.
examples.phonetic: /hiː mʌst hæv ə lɒt əv ˈmʌni bɪˈkɒz hiː draɪvz ə fəˈrɑːri/
examples.translation: Anapaswa kuwa na fedha nyingi kwa sababu anashikamana na Ferrari.
examples.note: Sababu inaingizwa na 'because' (kwa sababu) na inaonyesha makusanyiko.

levels.label: Possibility with might, may, and could
levels.translation: Uhitsuaji na might, may na could

examples.original: She might be at the gym right now.
examples.phonetic: /ʃiː maɪt biː æt ðə dʒɪm raɪt naʊ/
examples.translation: Anaweza kuwa katika jim nasasa hivi.
examples.note: 'Might' husema kuhusu uhitsuaji ambao ni chache kuliko 'must'. Katika Kihispania, 'puede que'.

examples.original: They may arrive late because of the traffic.
examples.phonetic: /ðeɪ meɪ əˈraɪv leɪt bɪˈkɒz əv ðə ˈtræfɪk/
examples.translation: Wanaweza kuja mara baadaye kwa sababu ya trafik.
examples.note: 'May' ni kama 'might', lakini mara nyingi ni kidemokrasiakali zaidi. Wote ni sahihi.

examples.original: This could be the best restaurant in the city.
examples.phonetic: /ðɪs kʊd biː ðə best ˈrestərɒnt ɪn ðə ˈsɪti/
examples.translation: Hii inaweza kuwa kiwanda kikubwa zaidi katika mji.
examples.note: 'Could' pia husema kuhusu uhitsuaji na hutumika sana katika mazungumzo.

examples.original: He must have studied a lot for the exam.
examples.phonetic: /hiː mʌst hæv ˈstʌdid ə lɒt fɔːr ði ɪɡˈzæm/
examples.translation: Anapaswa kuwa amejifunza mengi kwa ajili ya mtihani.
examples.note: Tunatumia 'must have + past participle' ili kuhusu makusanyiko katika wakati uliopita. Katika Kihispania, 'debe de haber'.

examples.original: She can't have seen us because she didn't wave.
examples.phonetic: /ʃiː kænt hæv siːn ʌs bɪˈkɒz ʃiː dɪdnt weɪv/
examples.translation: Hawezi kuwa ametuona kwa sababu hakutusalimia.
examples.note: 'Can't have + past participle' husema kuhusu makusanyiko ya kinyume katika wakati uliopita. Katika Kihispania, 'no puede haber'.

examples.original: They might have missed the bus.
examples.phonetic: /ðeɪ maɪt hæv mɪst ðə bʌs/
examples.translation: Wanaweza kuwa wamepotea basi.
examples.note: 'Might have + past participle' husema kuhusu uhitsuaji katika wakati uliopita. Katika Kihispania, 'puede que hayan'.

examples.original: The roads are wet. It must have rained.
examples.phonetic: /ðə roʊdz ɑːr wet. ɪt mʌst hæv reɪnd/
examples.translation: Njia zimejawa. Anapaswa kuwa amefurahia.
examples.note: Ushahidi wa sasa (njia zimejawa) unatuletea matokeo ya uhakika kuhusu wakati uliopita.

title: Expressing regret and hypothetical situations / Kushughulikia hasira na mazingatio
bridge: Katika Kiingereza, hutumia kipindi cha pacha na kipindi cha subjunctive kusema kuhusu mazingatio na hasira (kama vile, 'if I had time, I would go'). Katika Kiingereza, mbinu ni tofauti: hutumia kipindi cha zamani (au kipindi cha zamani ambalo) katika ibara ya 'if' na 'would' + verb katika ibara ya msingi. Hitilafu isiyo sahihi ni kutafsiri 'si tendría' kwa 'if I would have', lakini katika Kiingereza ibara ya 'if' hauna 'would'. Pia, kusema kuhusu mazingatio isiyo ya kweli zamani, hutumia kipindi cha zamani ambalo ('had + participio') badala ya kipindi cha pacha kilichojulikana.
rule: Katika Kiingereza B1, kushughulikia mazingatio ya sasa au ya siku ijayo (kipindi cha pacha cha pili), hutumia 'if + kipindi cha zamani' (au 'if + kipindi cha zamani inayotokea') katika ibara ya sharti, na 'would + forma ya msingi' katika ibara ya msingi. Mifano: 'If I had more time, I would travel.' (If I had more time, I would travel). Fikiria kwamba 'were' hutumika kwa watu wote na 'if I were' (ingawa 'was' ni ya kawaida katika Kiingereza isiyo rasmi). Kushughulikia hasira kuhusu zamani (kipindi cha pacha cha tatu), hutumia 'if + kipindi cha zamani ambalo' (had + participio) na 'would have + participio' katika msingi: 'If I had studied, I would have passed.' (If I had studied, I would have passed). Pia unaweza kutumia 'I wish' + kipindi cha zamani ambalo kwa hasira: 'I wish I had studied.' (I wish I had studied). Kumbuka kwamba ibara ya 'if' hauna 'would' wala 'will'. Katika mazingatio ya rasmi, 'were' inapendekezwa: 'If he were here...'.

concept_examples.text: If I had more money, I would buy a car.
concept_examples.translation: If I had more money, I would buy a car.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ɪf aɪ hæd mɔːr ˈmʌni aɪ wʊd baɪ ə kɑːr/

concept_examples.text: I wish I knew the answer.
concept_examples.translation: I wish I knew the answer.
concept_examples.phonetic: /aɪ wɪʃ aɪ nuː ði ˈænsər/

concept_examples.text: If she had studied harder, she would have passed the exam.
concept_examples.translation: If she had studied more, she would have passed the exam.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ɪf ʃiː hæd ˈstʌdid ˈhɑːrdər ʃiː wʊd hæv pæst ði ɪɡˈzæm/

concept_examples.text: I would travel more if I were younger.
concept_examples.translation: I would travel more if I were younger.
concept_examples.phonetic: /aɪ wʊd ˈtrævl mɔːr ɪf aɪ wɜːr ˈjʌŋɡər/

common_error.wrong: If I would have time, I would go to the party.
common_error.correct: If I had time, I would go to the party.
common_error.correct_alt: If I had time, I'd go to the party.
common_error.explanation: Hitilafu huhudhuria kwa sababu katika Kispanishi tusema 'si tendría tiempo' (kipindi cha pacha), lakini katika Kiingereza ibara ya 'if' hauna 'would'. Badala yake, tunatumia kipindi cha zamani (had). Ili kuiepuka hitilafu, kumbuka kwamba 'if' inatokana na kipindi cha zamani (kwa mazingatio ya sasa/ya siku ijayo) au kipindi cha zamani ambalo (kwa zamani), na 'would' tu inatoka katika ibara nyingine.

levels.label: Second conditional (present/future hypotheticals)
levels.translation: Kipindi cha pacha cha pili (mazingatio ya sasa/ya siku ijayo)

examples.original: If I won the lottery, I would travel the world.
examples.phonetic: /ɪf aɪ wʌn ðə ˈlɑːtəri aɪ wʊd ˈtrævl ðə wɜːrld/
examples.translation: If I won the lottery, I would travel around the world.
examples.note: Kumbuka kwamba 'won' ni kipindi cha zamani, hawa maana 'alipata' hapa.

examples.original: If he were taller, he could play basketball.
examples.phonetic: /ɪf hiː wɜːr ˈtɔːlər hiː kʊd pleɪ ˈbæskɪtbɔːl/
examples.translation: If I were taller, I could play basketball.
examples.note: Katika Kiingereza ya rasmi hutumika 'were' kwa watu wote, lakini 'was' ni ya kawaida katika isiyo rasmi.

examples.original: What would you do if you had a million dollars?
examples.phonetic: /wʌt wʊd juː duː ɪf juː hæd ə ˈmɪljən ˈdɑːlərz/
examples.translation: What would you do if you had a million dollars?
examples.note: Swali huhubiri utaratibu wa 'would' na mwanzo.

levels.label: Third conditional (past regret)
levels.translation: Kipindi cha pacha cha tatu (hasira kuhusu zamani)

examples.original: If I had known, I would have come earlier.
examples.phonetic: /ɪf aɪ hæd noʊn aɪ wʊd hæv kʌm ˈɜːrliər/
examples.translation: If I had known, I would have come earlier.
examples.note: Tumia kipindi cha zamani ambalo (had + participio) katika 'if' na 'would have + participio' katika msingi.

examples.original: She wouldn't have missed the train if she had left home on time.
examples.phonetic: /ʃiː ˈwʊdnt hæv mɪst ðə treɪn ɪf ʃiː hæd left hoʊm ɒn taɪm/
examples.translation: She would not have missed the train if she had left home on time.
examples.note: Pia unaweza kushiriki 'would not' kama 'wouldn't'.

examples.original: If we had booked in advance, we would have got a discount.
examples.phonetic: /ɪf wiː hæd bʊkt ɪn ədˈvɑːns wiː wʊd hæv ɡɒt ə ˈdɪskaʊnt/
examples.translation: If we had booked in advance, we would have gotten a discount.
examples.note: Katika Kiingereza cha Uingereza 'got' hutumika kama participio; katika Kiingereza cha Marekani mara nyingi 'gotten'.

examples.original: I wish I had studied more for the test.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ wɪʃ aɪ hæd ˈstʌdid mɔːr fər ðə test/
examples.translation: I wish I had studied more for the exam.
examples.note: Na 'wish' + kipindi cha zamani ambalo husema kuhusu hasira kuhusu zamani.

examples.original: I wish I could speak English fluently.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ wɪʃ aɪ kʊd spiːk ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ ˈfluːəntli/
examples.translation: I wish I could speak English fluently.
examples.note: Na 'could' + verb husema kuhusu tamani kuhusu ujuzi wa sasa.

examples.original: I wish it weren't raining today.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ wɪʃ ɪt wɜːrnt ˈreɪnɪŋ təˈdeɪ/
examples.translation: I wish it were not raining today.
examples.note: Na 'wish' + kipindi cha zamani inayotokea husema kuhusu tamani kuhusu hali ya sasa.

title: Discussing Advantages and Disadvantages / Kuzungumza kuhusu Matokeo Mema na Mabaya
bridge: Katika Kiingereza, inawazika kutumia 'advantages' na 'disadvantages' kama vituo, lakini ni kawaida sana kutumia vitenzi 'advantages' na 'disadvantages' na vitendo kama 'have' au 'there are'. Pia, katika Kiingereza hutumika 'pros and cons' katika mazingira ya kawaida, jambo ambalo halina mfanuo tofauti katika Kihispania. Heshima kutafsiri 'por un lado' kama 'for one side' – lafazili sahihi ni 'on the one hand'.
rule:
Kuzungumza kuhusu matokeo mema na mabaya katika Kiingereza kwenye ngazi B1, tumia mifumo haya:
1. 'One advantage (of) is that...' / 'One disadvantage (of) is that...' – inayofuatawa na ibara yenye mwadinio na kitenzi.
2. 'The advantages of + jina/gerund are...' kwa kuweka orodha.
3. 'On the one hand... on the other hand...' kwa kuweka tofauti kati ya mawazo mawili.
4. 'However' au 'Nevertheless' kwa kuweka upande wa mabaya baada ya kuzungumza kuhusu mema.
5. 'Pros and cons' ni lafazili iliyothibitishwa inayofanya kazi kama jina la mbalimbali: 'Let's weigh the pros and cons.'
Kumbuka kwamba katika Kiingereza hautumiki 'of' baada ya 'advantage' wakati hapana jina linalotokana: 'It has many advantages' (si 'advantages of').

concept_examples.text: One advantage of living in a big city is that there are more job opportunities.
concept_examples.translation: Ujumla mmoja wa kuishi katika mjini mkubwa ni kwamba kuna fursa zaidi za ajira.
concept_examples.phonetic: wʌn ədˈvæntɪdʒ əv ˈlɪvɪŋ ɪn ə bɪɡ ˈsɪti ɪz ðæt ðer ɑːr mɔːr dʒɒb ˌɒpəˈtjuːnɪtiz

concept_examples.text: On the other hand, the cost of living is much higher.
concept_examples.translation: Pande zingine, gharama za maisha ni zaidi sana.
concept_examples.phonetic: ɒn ðə ˈʌðə hænd, ðə kɒst əv ˈlɪvɪŋ ɪz mʌtʃ ˈhaɪə

concept_examples.text: A major disadvantage of working from home is that you may feel isolated.
concept_examples.translation: Ujumla mkubwa wa kufanya kazi nyumbani ni kwamba unaweza kuhisi uwanja.

title: Narrating a story / Kucambia hadithi au kumbukumbu
bridge: Katika Kiingereza, kuweka hadithi katika zamani hutumia hasa 'past simple' na 'past continuous', na tofauti kati yao ni muhimu. Katika Kihispania, mambo ni karibu lakini na tofauti kadiri: 'pretérito indefinido' na 'imperfecto' hutumika kwa ajili ya matukio yaliyokamilika na yaliyokuwa yanatendeka zamani. Kosa nyingi inayotokea ni kuweka 'estaba + gerundio' moja kwa moja katika Kiingereza, lakini katika Kiingereza mara nyingi hutumika 'used to' au 'would' kwa ajili ya tabia za zamani, ambazo hana mfano tofauti katika Kihispania. Pia uwe makini: 'past perfect' (had + participio) hutumika zaidi katika Kiingereza kuliko 'pluscuamperfecto' katika Kihispania kuwakilisha matukio yaliyotangulia katika hadithi.
rule:
Kucambia hadithi katika Kiingereza kwenye ngazi B1, unahitaji kujua mada wa kipindi hivi:
1. **Past Simple** (kwa kutoa: mwanzo + kipindi kilichopita, mfano 'walked'; kwa kushika: 'didn't + kipindi'; kwa kuliuliza: 'Did + mwanzo + kipindi?'). Hutumika kwa ajili ya matukio yaliyokamilika katika zamani, katika mstari.
2. **Past Continuous** (was/were + kipindi -ing). Huelezea matukio yaliyokuwa yanatendeka katika kipindi fulani cha zamani, mara nyingi yaliyokatizwa na tukio fulani (past simple).
3. **Past Perfect** (had + participio kilichopita). Huonyesha tukio lililokuwa limefanyika kabla ya nyingine katika zamani. Hauhumiki sana kama katika Kihispania, lakini ni muhimu kuwakilisha mstari.
4. **'Used to'** (mwanzo + used to + kipindi cha msingi) kwa ajili ya tabia au hali za zamani ambazo hazipo tena.
5. **'Would'** kwa ajili ya tabia za zamani (katika hadithi rasmi au ya kiandiko).
Nakala za muda: 'first', 'then', 'after that', 'suddenly', 'finally', n.k. Huasaidia kuweka hadithi.
Ustari: mifano ya kipindi isiyotengenezwa (go-went-gone, see-saw-seen). Kumbuka kwamba katika kushika na kuliuliza hutumia 'did' na kipindi cha msingi.
Kwa ajili ya ngazi B1, achia 'past perfect continuous' (ni zaidi ya juu).

concept_examples.text: I was walking home when I saw an old friend.
concept_examples.translation: Nilipokuwa nikiongea nyumbani nilipata rafiki yangu wa zamani.

concept_examples.phonetic: /fɜːrst ʃi ˈfɪnɪʃt hɜːr ˈhoʊmwɜːrk ðɛn ʃi wɛnt aʊt/

concept_examples.text: I used to play football every weekend when I was a kid.

concept_examples.phonetic: /aɪ juːst tuː pleɪ ˈfʊtbɔːl ˈɛvri ˈwiːkɛnd wɛn aɪ wəz ə kɪd/

common_error.wrong: I was used to play tennis every summer.
common_error.correct: I used to play tennis every summer.
common_error.correct_alt: I would play tennis every summer.
common_error.explanation: Kosa hii hutokea kwa sababu katika Kihispania husema 'solía + infinitivo', na wakati wa kuweka, wanafunzi wengine huongeza 'was' wakifikiri ni lazima. Lakini 'used to' bado ina maana ya zamani na haihitaji 'was/were'. Pia huweza kuwashawishi na mbinu 'be used to + gerundio' ambayo maana yake ni 'kuwa na tabia'. Kwa ajili ya tabia za zamani, tumia 'used to + kipindi cha msingi' au 'would + kipindi cha msingi' (bila 'be').

examples.original: Once upon a time, there was a little girl who lived in a village.
examples.phonetic: /wʌns əˈpɒn ə taɪm ðɛər wəz ə ˈlɪtl ɡɜːrl huː lɪvd ɪn ə ˈvɪlɪdʒ/
examples.translation: Hapo zamani za kale, kulikuwa na msichana mdogo aliyekuwa akikaa katika kijiji.

examples.original: One day, I decided to go on a trip to the mountains.

examples.translation: Siku moja, niliamua kufanya safari kwenye milima.
examples.note: Tumi 'decided' katika past simple kuwakilisha tukio fulani lililowanza hadithi.

examples.original: It was a sunny morning and the birds were singing.
examples.phonetic: /ɪt wəz ə ˈsʌni ˈmɔːrnɪŋ ænd ðə bɜːrdz wɜːr ˈsɪŋɪŋ/
examples.translation: Ilikuwa asubuhi yenye jua na ndege walikuwa wanai.
examples.note: Kwa ajili ya kuelezea mazingira, tumia past continuous ('were singing') na 'was' kwa ajili ya hali ya hewa.

examples.original: While I was driving, suddenly I saw a deer in the middle of the road.
examples.phonetic: /waɪl aɪ wəz ˈdraɪvɪŋ ˈsʌdənli aɪ sɔː ə dɪr ɪn ðə ˈmɪdl əv ðə roʊd/
examples.translation: Nilipokuwa nikiongea, ghafula niliwona punda milia katikati ya barabara.
examples.note: Tukio lililokuwa linatendeka (past continuous) limekatizwa na tukio fulani (past simple 'saw').

examples.original: First, we visited the museum, then we had lunch at a nice restaurant.
examples.phonetic: /fɜːrst wiː ˈvɪzɪtɪd ðə mjuːˈziːəm ðɛn wiː hæd lʌntʃ æt ə naɪs ˈrɛstərɒnt/

examples.note: Tumi nakala kama 'first' na 'then' kuweka matukio katika past simple.

examples.original: After we had finished the presentation, the boss asked us some questions.
examples.phonetic: /ˈæftər wiː hæd ˈfɪnɪʃt ðə ˌprɛzənˈteɪʃən ðə bɒs ɑːskt ʌs sʌm ˈkwɛstʃənz/
examples.translation: Baada ya tulipoimaliza utangulizi, mkuu alituuliza maswali machache.
examples.note: Past perfect ('had finished') huonyesha kwamba tukio fulani lilikuwa limefanyika kabla ya nyingine (alituuliza).

examples.original: In the end, we finally found the hotel after getting lost for an hour.
examples.phonetic: /ɪn ðiː ɛnd wiː ˈfaɪnəli faʊnd ðə hoʊˈtɛl ˈæftər ˈɡɛtɪŋ lɒst fɔːr ən ˈaʊər/
examples.translation: Mwishowe, tulificaa hoteli baada ya kupotea kwa saa moja.
examples.note: Tumi 'in the end' kufika mwisho, na 'finally' kuwakilisha kwamba lilikuwa baada ya tatizo.

examples.original: It was an unforgettable experience because I learned a lot about myself.
examples.phonetic: /ɪt wəz ən ʌnfərˈɡɛtəbl ɪkˈspɪəriəns bɪˈkɒz aɪ lɜːrnd ə lɒt əˈbaʊt maɪˈsɛlf/

examples.note: Kwa ajili ya kufikiri, tumia 'it was + adjective' na 'because' + mstari unaotumia past simple.

examples.original: Looking back, I think I would do things differently now.
examples.phonetic: /ˈlʊkɪŋ bæk aɪ θɪŋk aɪ wʊd duː θɪŋz ˈdɪfərəntli naʊ/

examples.note: Tumi 'looking back' kuanza kufikiri, na 'would' kwa ajili ya uhakika.

title: Kutoa maoni kuhusu mwangazo / Argumentar un punto de vista
bridge: Katika Kiingereza, kutoa maoni hutumia juma kama vile 'ninyi ninafikiri' au 'nimeamini kwamba', na mara nyingi hutua mwadilishi kwa sababu kisemi kinachokumbuka. Katika Kiingereza, mwadilishi ni lazima na hutumia mifumo kama vile 'Nafikiri kwamba...' au 'Katika maoni yangu...'. Pia, katika Kiingereza inaongezeka kutumia 'should' kutoa maoni au mashauri, wakati wa Kiswahili tunatumia 'lazima' au 'ingekuwa bora'. Angalia usisie tafsiri kwa maneno 'ninyi ninafikiri kwamba' kama 'I think that' (sahihi) lakini usisahau mwadilishi: 'Nafikiri kwamba' = 'I think that' (si 'Think that'). Hitilafu nyingine ni kutumia 'I am agree' badala ya 'I agree', kwa sababu katika Kiswahili 'kuwa na ujumbe' hutumia 'kuwa' lakini katika Kiingereza 'agree' ni kisemi rahisi.
rule:
Kutoa maoni kuhusu mwangazo katika Kiingereza kwa kipaji B1, tumia mifumo ifuatayo:

1. **Kutoa maoni:** 'Nafikiri kwamba...', 'Nimeamini kwamba...', 'Katika maoni yangu...', 'Kutoka kwenye mwangazo wangu...'. Mifano: 'Nafikiri kwamba kutoa tena ni jambo la maana.'
2. **Kutoa sababu:** 'kwa sababu', 'tangu', 'kama'. Mifano: 'Nimeamini kwamba tunapaswa kuhifadhi maji kwa sababu ni ya maana kwa maisha.'
3. **Kutoa mapendekezo au mashauri:** 'should' + kisemi cha msingi (bila 'to'). Mifano: 'Watu wanapaswa kutumia njia za umma zaidi.'
4. **Kuwa na ujumbe / si na ujumbe:** 'Nina ujumbe', 'Sina ujumbe', 'Nina ujumbe nawe', 'Sina ujumbe'. Nota: 'agree' ni kisemi, si sifa, kwa hiyo usitumie 'be + agree'. Mifano: 'Nina ujumbe na mawazo yako.' (Si: 'I am agree').
5. **Kudhibiti:** 'Lakini', 'lakini', 'kwenye upande mwingine'. Mifano: 'Watu wengine hufikiri hivyo, lakini mimi sina ujumbe.'

Kumbuka kwamba katika Kiingereza mwadilishi ni lazima, hata katika majibu fupi: 'Nina ujumbe' si 'Ujumbe'. Pia, 'fikiri' na 'amini' yanaweza kutoka baada ya 'kwamba' (chochote) au moja kwa moja na laini. Kwa B1, ni kutosha kutumia 'kwamba' kwa ufanisi. Sifa hutumika na 'be' (I am sure), lakini mifano ya maoni hayatumii 'be'.

concept_examples.text: I think that online learning is very useful.
concept_examples.translation: Nimeamini kwamba masomo ya mtandao ni ya faida sana.
concept_examples.phonetic: /aɪ θɪŋk ðæt ˈɒnlaɪn ˈlɜːnɪŋ ɪz ˈveri ˈjuːsfəl/

concept_examples.text: In my opinion, we should reduce plastic use.
concept_examples.translation: Katika maoni yangu, tunapaswa kupunguza kutumia plastiki.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ɪn maɪ əˈpɪnjən wi ʃʊd rɪˈdjuːs ˈplæstɪk juːs/

concept_examples.text: I disagree with that idea because it's too expensive.
concept_examples.translation: Sina ujumbe na mawazo hayo kwa sababu ni ghali sana.
concept_examples.phonetic: /aɪ ˌdɪsəˈɡriː wɪð ðæt aɪˈdɪə bɪˈkɒz ɪts tuː ɪkˈspensɪv/

concept_examples.text: You should consider both sides of the argument.
concept_examples.translation: Unapaswa kufikiri upande mwingine wa jambo hili.
concept_examples.phonetic: /juː ʃʊd kənˈsɪdər bəʊθ saɪdz əv ði ˈɑːɡjumənt/

common_error.explanation: Hitilafu hii hutokea kwa sababu katika Kiswahili husema 'nina ujumbe' kutumia kisemi 'kuwa', ambacho katika Kiingereza hutafsiriwa kama 'be'. Lakini, katika Kiingereza 'agree' ni kisemi nzuri, si sifa, kwa hiyo haipatikanii kutumika na 'be'. Ili kufikia, tumia moja kwa moja 'I agree' au 'I disagree'. Badilisha nyingine ni 'I'm with you' katika mazingira ya kawaida. Kumbuka: na kisemi 'agree' usitumie 'be'.

examples.original: I think that this movie is great.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ θɪŋk ðæt ðɪs ˈmuːvi ɪz ɡreɪt/
examples.translation: Nafikiri kwamba filamu hii ni nzuri.
examples.note: Tumia 'I think that' kutoa maoni yako kwa ufanisi. 'That' ni chochote, lakini husaidia kufafanua.

examples.original: In my opinion, fast food is unhealthy.
examples.phonetic: /ɪn maɪ əˈpɪnjən fɑːst fuːd ɪz ʌnˈhelθi/
examples.translation: Katika maoni yangu, chakula haraka si afya.
examples.note: 'In my opinion' ni jina la kawaida na rasmi. Hutumika mwanzo wa laini.

examples.original: I believe that we can solve this problem.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ bɪˈliːv ðæt wi kæn sɒlv ðɪs ˈprɒbləm/
examples.translation: Nimeamini kwamba tunaweza kutatua tatizo hili.
examples.note: 'Believe' ni nguvu zaidi kuliko 'think'. Hutumika kwa maoni ya nguvu zaidi.

levels.label: Agreeing and Disagreeing
levels.translation: Kuwa na ujumbe na si na ujumbe

examples.original: I agree with your opinion about the environment.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ əˈɡriː wɪð jɔːr əˈpɪnjən əˈbaʊt ði ɪnˈvaɪrənmənt/
examples.translation: Nina ujumbe na maoni yako kuhusu mazingira.
examples.note: Tumia 'agree with' + mtu/maoni. Usitumie 'be' kabla ya 'agree'.

examples.original: I don't agree with that decision.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ dəʊnt əˈɡriː wɪð ðæt dɪˈsɪʒən/
examples.translation: Sina ujumbe na uamuzi huo.
examples.note: Mifano ya kimya ni 'don't agree', si 'am not agree'.

examples.original: I disagree completely.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ ˌdɪsəˈɡriː kəmˈpliːtli/
examples.translation: Nina ujumbe kwa ujumla.
examples.note: 'Disagree' ni kisemi. Unaweza kuinua na maneno kama vile 'completely' au 'totally'.

examples.original: You're right, but I still think we should wait.
examples.phonetic: /jɔːr raɪt bʌt aɪ stɪl θɪŋk wi ʃʊd weɪt/
examples.translation: Una haki, lakini bado nafikiri tunapaswa kusubiri.
examples.note: Ili kuonyesha ujumbe wa sehemu, tumia 'but' na baadaye maoni yako.

examples.original: I think we should recycle because it helps the planet.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ θɪŋk wi ʃʊd ˌriːˈsaɪkəl bɪˈkɒz ɪt helps ðə ˈplænɪt/
examples.translation: Nimeamini kwamba tunapaswa kutoa tena kwa sababu husaidia dunia.
examples.note: Tumia 'because' kutoa sababu. Kumbuka kwamba 'should' hutumika na kisemi cha msingi.

examples.original: Some people say that, but I have a different point of view.
examples.phonetic: /sʌm ˈpiːpl seɪ ðæt bʌt aɪ hæv ə ˈdɪfrənt pɔɪnt əv vjuː/
examples.translation: Watu wengine husema hivyo, lakini mimi nina mwangazo mwingine.
examples.note: Ili kudhibiti, tumia 'but' na baadaye kutoa maoni yako na 'I have'.

examples.original: On the other hand, there are some advantages.
examples.phonetic: /ɒn ði ˈʌðə hænd ðeər ə sʌm ədˈvɑːntɪdʒɪz/
examples.translation: Kwenye upande mwingine, kuna matokeo ya kufaa.
examples.note: Launi 'on the other hand' hutumika kutoa upande mwingine au mwangazo mwingine.

examples.original: Although it's expensive, I still think it's worth it.
examples.phonetic: /ɔːlˈðəʊ ɪts ɪkˈspensɪv aɪ stɪl θɪŋk ɪts wɜːθ ɪt/
examples.translation: Ijapokuwa ni ghali, bado nafikiri ni ya maana.
examples.note: 'Although' hutumika kutoa ujumbe. Usitumie 'but' kwa mara moja: 'Although it's expensive, I think...' (si 'but')

title: Talking about your job and career / Kuzungumza kuhusu kazi yako na karieri yako
bridge: Katika Kiingereza hutumika kifuatano 'work as' (I work as a doctor) au 'be' (I am a doctor) kwa kuwashughulisha verb 'work'. Pia, Kiingereza hufariki kwa waziwazi kati ya 'work' (jina la kawaida) na 'job' (kazi maalum), wakati wa Kispanishi tunatumia 'trabajo' kwa wawili. Pia, uwe makini na present simple: Katika Kispanishi tunaweza kushuka mwadilishi, lakini katika Kiingereza lazima uwe na mwadilishi.
rule:
Kuzungumza kuhusu kazi na karieri katika Kiingereza kwa ngazi ya B1, tumia:
- Present simple kuwashifisha kazi yako ya sasa: 'I work as a teacher' (ni mwalimu) au 'I am a teacher'.
- 'Work in' + sektari au mahali (I work in a hospital), 'work for' + kampuni (I work for Microsoft), 'work with' + watu au vitu (I work with children).
- Kuzungumza kuhusu karieri yako, tumia 'career' (mshirika) na 'job' (kazi maalum). Kwa mfano: 'I'm looking for a new job' (ninataka kazi jipya), 'She has a successful career' (ana karieri yenye mafanikio).
- Kutumia matamanio au mipango ya siku ijayo, tumia 'would like to' + infinitive (I'd like to change careers) au 'planning to' (I'm planning to look for a new job).
- Kumbuka magari ya utelemavu: 'always', 'usually', 'often', 'sometimes', 'never' kuzungumza kuhusu rutini za kazi.

title: Describing processes / Kutafuta mchakato (jinsi kitu kinafanya kazi)
bridge: Katika Kiingereza, mara nyingi tunatumbia mchakato kwa kutumia sauti iliyopaswa na 'is/are + past participle' (kwa mfano, 'the water is heated') na viungo vya mchakato kama 'first', 'then', 'next', 'after that', 'finally'. Kuna kinyonga kinachokuwepo kwamba katika Kispanishi huwa tunapotea mwanzo, lakini katika Kiingereza sauti iliyopaswa mara nyingi ina mwanzo au hutumika utaratibu wa kila mtu na 'you' au 'they'. Pia, utaratibu wa maneno katika Kiingereza ni ngumu zaidi: kwanza mwanzo, kisha verb, na magari ya utelemavu huenda kabla ya verb mkuu lakini baada ya 'be'.
rule: Kutafuta mchakato katika Kiingereza kwenye ngazi ya B1, hutumika kwa kawaida hali ya sasa (kwa masuala ya jumla) na sauti iliyopaswa (present passive: am/is/are + past participle) wakati uhakika umewekwa kwenye hatua na si kwenye anayefanya. Utaratibu wa kawaida ni: Kwanza, [jambo] is/are + past participle. Kisha huongezwa viungo vya mchakato: first, then, next, after that, later, finally. Pia inaweza kutumika amr (kama katika maelezo) au 'you' utaratibu. Sauti iliyopaswa hutoa: mwanzo + verb 'to be' iliyosahihiwa + past participle. Kwa mfano: 'The coffee is ground.' Usisahau kwamba magari ya utelemavu (always, usually, often) huenda kabla ya verb mkuu lakini baada ya 'be' (kwa mfano, 'The water is always heated first'). Katika Kiingereza, tofauti na Kispanishi, 'se' hautumiki kwa sauti iliyopaswa; hutumika sauti iliyopaswa na 'be' au utaratibu wa kufanya kazi na 'you'.

title: Expressing uncertainty and possibility / Kushuhudia utajiri na uwezo
bridge: Katika Kiingereza hutumia vitendo vya kiwango cha kwanza kama 'might' na 'could' au vifaa kama 'maybe' na 'perhaps' kushuhudia utajiri, lakini katika Kiingereza hakuna kiwango cha kwanza cha jumla; badala yake hutumia vitendo vya kiwango cha kwanza kama 'might' na 'could' au vifaa kama 'maybe' na 'perhaps'. Heshima: 'must' si 'debe' kwa uwezo, bali inaonyesha ufikiri mkubwa (debe de).
rule: Kushuhudia utajiri katika Kiingereza, hutumia: 1) Vifaa: 'maybe', 'perhaps', 'probably', 'definitely' (mwanzo au baada ya jina). 2) Vitendo vya kiwango cha kwanza: 'may', 'might', 'could' kwa uwezo (may/might ni zaidi ya rasmi; could ni zaidi ya kawaida katika yakini). 3) 'Must' kwa ufikiri wa mawazo: 'She must be at home'. 4) Uchalito 'be likely to' au 'be unlikely to' kwa uwezo. Katika maghubu, hutumia 'might not' au 'may not' (si 'could not' kwa uwezo, kwa sababu 'couldn't' maana uwezo wa zamani).

Lakini katika Kiingereza, baada ya vitendo vya kiwango cha kwanza (may, might, could, must) hutumia kiwango cha kwanza bila 'to'. Kumbuka: modal + kiwango cha msingi.

title: Making formal requests / Ombi rasmi na andiko ya rasmi ya msingi
bridge: Katika Kiingereza, mara nyingi hutumia sharti ('Would you...?', 'Could you...?') kwa ajili ya ombi rasmi. Pia ni kawaida sana kutumia 'Would you mind...?' inayofuata na majina ya kushtaki (-ing), ambayo hauna mfano wa kina katika Kihispania. Uwaache kutafsiri haraka '¿Te importaría...?' kama 'Would you care...?', kwa kuwa inasikiliza kama ya zamani. Pia kumbuka kwamba katika Kiingereza ya rasmi, 'please' huwa katika mwisho au baada ya fiili ya sharti, si mwanzo kama katika Kihispania.
rule:
Kwa ajili ya kuweka ombi rasmi katika Kiingereza (uasili B1), tumia mifumo ifuatayo:
1. **Would you + fiili ya msingi...?** – 'Would you send me the report?' (Je, unaweza kunitumia ripoti?). Ni kiutu na kawaida.
2. **Could you + fiili ya msingi...?** – 'Could you help me with this?' (Je, unaweza kusaidia na hii?). Inafanana na 'Would', lakini kidogo cha kiwango cha chini cha rasmi.
3. **Would you mind + majina ya kushtaki (-ing)?** – 'Would you mind closing the window?' (Je, unataka kufunga dirisha?). Mfumo huu ni kiutu sana na hutumika kwa ajili ya vitendo vinavyoweza kushitisha. Jibu 'No, not at all' kamwe haikukushitisha.
4. **Ningtaki + fiili ya msingi** – 'Ningtaki kuweka ombi ya rudufu.' (Ningtaki kuweka ombi ya rudufu). Kwa kuelezea ombi wako mwenyewe.
5. **Maswali ya rasmi na 'Would it be possible to...?'** – 'Would it be possible to reschedule the meeting?' (Je, ni nyingi kuweka tena mikutano?). Ni rasmi sana, inatumika katika barua za barua pepe.
Kumbuka: katika Kiingereza, 'please' hutumika katika mwisho wa jina au baada ya mwanzo wa maswali, si mwanzo kama katika Kihispania. Mfano: 'Could you help me, please?' si 'Please, could you help me?'.

translations.sw: Ombi rasmi na andiko ya rasmi ya msingi
